title: HomeView Sentinel control request, version 1
description: Written by a client to ~/Library/Application Support/HomeView Sentinel/control/request.json (temporary file and rename). The control agent reads it within 2 seconds, deletes it, and reports its id as applied_request or refused_request in state.json. A newer request replaces one not read yet.

id.description: Chosen by the client, e.g. a UUID.

hours.description: Only for timed: the watch ends this many hours from when it is applied.
